SSI263 P7 die-derived parameter ROM and coefficient generator
===============================================================

Source of 64 x 9 decoded parameter entries:
kue-m/mockingboard-pico
  firmware/vendor/ssi263/ssi263_defaults.h
  https://github.com/kue-m/mockingboard-pico

Underlying ROM and decoded SSI chip data:
Tamas Geczy, ssi263-speech, Copyright (c) 2026, MIT
  https://github.com/lprazdnik/ssi263-speech
  https://github.com/tgeczy/ssi263-speech
  src/data/rom_bits.csv and src/ssi263/rom.py

The original ROM bit cells were decoded from silicon photographs
hosted by Visual6502.org (Greg James; stitched by Christian Sattler).

Our tools/generate_ssi263_die_formants.py uses the decoded entries to
derive new fixed-point 16 kHz filter coefficients. That new Verilog
filter implementation is experimental and is NOT identical to the
upstream software's calibrated C99 switched-capacitor synth.

This branch deliberately uses no MAME SC-01 glottal waveform and
imports none of the upstream firmware or commercial device voices.
Keep this NOTICE and LICENSE with distributions of the relevant code.
